test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man purchases a washing machine for Rs. 12,000. He pays Rs. 2,000 at first and the rest after 1 year, on which he is charged a simple interest at the rate of 10% per year. The total amount he pays for the washing machine is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 12,000

Down payment = Rs. 2,000

Time (t) = 1 year

Rate (r) = 10% per year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × r × t) / 100

**Calculation:**

Interest will be incurred on the amount = 12000 - 2000 = 10000

⇒ SI = (10,000 × 10 × 1) / 100

⇒ SI = 1,000

Total amount paid = Principal + SI

⇒ Total amount = 12,000 + 1,000

⇒ Total amount = Rs. 13,000.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
